comments.body: Of course they would keep releasing those ships, because FS ships are getting better and better every new update. In later Chapter 3, they finally have a new battleship that surpass more than 1.500 dura after proper improvement, something that only uwc superior-tier ships have in this server. If FS ships are eventually become as strong as uwc ships, people will less interest with uwc ships. Like, why bother if the buildable ships are same strong too? That's why they want to make the "gap" between FS and cash ship to make sure people don't give a crap to FS battleship and just buy the cash one. Very shameful trick but whatever, they love money.
